title: Comparing Two-Digit Numbers
objective: Compare two two-digit numbers by comparing tens first, then ones only if the tens are equal.
studentQuestion: Which number is bigger — how can you tell without counting everything?
newIdea: An efficient comparison procedure grounded in place value, replacing full recounting.

teaching.setup: Two numbers, e.g. 34 and 27, each shown as bundles + loose ones.
teaching.break: Compare the tens digits first; only compare ones if tens are tied.
teaching.build: State the comparison (34 > 27, because 3 tens beats 2 tens, regardless of ones).
teaching.transform: The same two quantities, compared efficiently by place value instead of a full one-by-one count.

check.prompt: Fully unbundle and count both to confirm the comparison.

examples.transfer: 34 vs. 34 (equal — both tens and ones tied).

mastery.evidence: Correctly compares 3 pairs of two-digit numbers, including one tied-tens case, using tens-first reasoning.
